name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Embossed Frosted Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 1 layer of 3mm frosted acrylic, providing a durable, elegant, and semi-translucent base for personalized decorative signage.
    - Features a smooth glossy frosted acrylic surface with raised embossed contour lines that create a distinctive dimensional finish.
    - Raised line details add texture, depth, and a handcrafted stained-glass-inspired appearance to the artwork.
    - The frosted acrylic background softly diffuses light while allowing colorful printed details to remain visually prominent.
    - Custom-shape construction allows the sign to be produced in decorative silhouettes that complement the artwork and intended display style.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available size: 16 x 24 in ~ 40.64 x 60.96 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Features high-quality UV printing on frosted acrylic for vibrant colors, fine details, personalized text, floral artwork, and decorative graphics.
    - The glossy surface incorporates raised embossed contour lines to highlight selected outlines and artwork details.
    - Embossed lines add tactile texture and dimensional depth, helping recreate the elegant appearance of handcrafted stained glass.
    - Precision cutting is used to create clean edges and custom-shaped sign silhouettes.
    - The combination of frosted acrylic, vivid printed artwork, and raised detailing creates a premium decorative finish suitable for statement signage.
    📌 Please Note: Raised line effects on flat surfaces will only be applied when the required raised-line elements are included in the customer’s artwork file.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized decorative sign for baby showers, weddings, bridal showers, birthdays, receptions, parties, celebrations, and special events.
    - Suitable for displaying custom names, dates, invitations, welcome messages, event details, quotes, and decorative artwork.
    - Ideal for use as a welcome sign, event entrance display, table or backdrop decoration, photo-area accent, or home décor piece.
    - The frosted acrylic surface creates a soft translucent effect that complements colorful stained-glass-inspired designs.
    - Raised contour details enhance the visual impact of floral, ornamental, and illustrated artwork.
    - Durable construction allows the sign to be kept after the event as a personalized decorative keepsake.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A beautiful personalized gift for new parents, couples, newlyweds, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for baby showers, weddings, bridal showers, anniversaries, birthdays, housewarmings, and milestone celebrations.
    - Great for creating custom event signage featuring names, meaningful dates, personalized messages, or themed artwork.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake that can continue to be displayed after the celebration.
    - A distinctive personalized décor piece combining elegant frosted acrylic with colorful artwork and dimensional raised detailing.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Embossed Frosted Acrylic Sign

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
